title: Night window slack off by an hour on DST nights
text: On the night of the November clock change, dispatch re-sequenced two Hartline night deliveries into Newark because the board said they would miss the 22:00-06:00 receiving window, and both trucks then sat at the gate for an hour. For the window opening Saturday 2026-10-31, a truck with an ETA of 05:00 UTC (01:00 EDT) showed 300 minutes of slack, but the window closes at 06:00 EST, which is 360 real minutes later. The board also shows that window as 480 minutes long instead of 540. The numbers come from `slack_minutes` and `window_minutes` in `delivery_window.py`.
